content: Root cause was two independent Windows/.NET packaging gotchas, not the plugin manifests themselves: (1) Compress-Archive emits backslash-separated zip entry paths, invalid per the zip spec and rejected by Cowork's validator; (2) .NET file APIs resolve relative paths against the process's real working directory, not PowerShell's Set-Location target, so the first version of the fix script silently wrote to the wrong place. Both are now encoded in a reusable, committed script (scripts/New-PluginZip.ps1) rather than living only as a one-off manual PowerShell run, so any future plugin re-zip reuses the fix instead of re-discovering it.
